name: The Mandatum Foundation
intro: At The Mandatum Foundation, we are dedicated to ensuring retiring Special Operations members transition successfully and smoothly into civilian life. Through individualized executive coaching, strategic networking, hands-on work experience, mentorship, and exposure to new skills or trades, we help them bridge resume gaps, explore certification pathways, and secure meaningful post-service employment.
mission: We prepare retiring elite Special Operations members for fulfilling civilian careers, empowering them to shape their next chapter with confidence and purpose.
vision: To be the trusted partner for retiring elite Special Operations members empowering purposeful transitions and building a strong and supportive network beyond service.
